fields.name: cohort_window_id
fields.description: ID of the cohort window that closed. Complementary to Cohort Window Opened.

fields.name: transaction_id
fields.description: Transaction ID for this charge. Source TBD.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether POST /transaction/initialize succeeded. This is the API call, not whether the customer paid.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Paystack's message for the initialize call. The sample is "Authorization URL created".

fields.name: authorization_url
fields.description: Hosted checkout URL from data.authorization_url. The customer is sent here.

fields.name: access_code
fields.description: Checkout access code from data.access_code.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Transaction reference from data.reference. Later verify and webhooks use this.

fields.name: user_id
fields.description: User ID of the learner initiating the license purchase.

fields.name: cohort_window_id
fields.description: Cohort window ID for the license being purchased.

fields.name: email
fields.description: User email for Paystack initialize (customer email required by Paystack).

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Amount to be paid in kobo for Paystack initialize.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Paystack POST /transaction/initialize succeeded (true). This is the API call, not whether the customer paid.

fields.name: message
fields.description: Paystack message for a successful initialize. Sample: "Authorization URL created".

fields.name: data.authorization_url
fields.description: Hosted checkout URL from data.authorization_url. The customer is sent here.

fields.name: data.access_code
fields.description: Checkout access code from data.access_code.

fields.name: data.reference
fields.description: Transaction reference from data.reference. Later verify and webhooks use this. Populates SingleChargeInitiated.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Paystack request failed (false).

fields.name: message
fields.description: Brief description of the error. Examples: "Invalid Amount Sent", "Email Address is required", "Invalid key".

fields.name: type
fields.description: Error category from Paystack: api_error, validation_error, or processor_error.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Paystack-defined error code that categorizes the failure (e.g. missing_params).

fields.name: meta.nextStep
fields.description: Suggested action to resolve the issue from the error meta object.

nodes.name: Record Customer Redirect From Checkout Page To Success URL
nodes.notes: Issued from the Success Auto-Redirect URL after Paystack checkout. Produces Customer Redirected From Checkout Page To Success URL.

nodes.name: Record Customer Redirect From Checkout Page To Cancel URL
nodes.notes: Issued from the Failure Auto-Redirect URL after Paystack checkout. Produces Customer Redirected From Checkout Page To Cancel URL.

nodes.name: Leave Group
nodes.notes: Command exists; no product UI wired yet (LeaveGroup)

nodes.name: License Purchase Page
nodes.notes: In-app payment page that hands the customer off to hosted Paystack checkout. Reconnects the License Checkout Modal path.

nodes.name: Transaction Status Page
nodes.notes: In-app landing page after Paystack auto-redirect URLs. Stands alone — does not issue a command.

fields.name: cohort_window_id

fields.description: Display name of the cohort window.

fields.name: price

fields.name: cohort_window_id
fields.description: ID of the open cohort window shown on this card.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name of the open cohort window.

nodes.name: Paystack Checkout Page
nodes.notes: EXTERNAL — Hosted Paystack checkout outside the product. Customer pays here, then hits a success or failure auto-redirect URL.

nodes.name: Success Auto-Redirect URL
nodes.notes: Paystack success return URL. Issues Record Customer Redirect From Checkout Page To Success URL, then redirects to the Transaction Status Page.

nodes.name: Failure Auto-Redirect URL
nodes.notes: Paystack failure/cancel return URL. Issues Record Customer Redirect From Checkout Page To Cancel URL, then redirects to the Transaction Status Page.
